name: Zethan
overview: Zethan was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, known primarily as the son of Bilhan. His mention in Scripture is brief and focused on his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, without additional narrative details or notable events recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Zethan means "olive tree" or "one who deals in olives," reflecting a Hebrew proper name with agricultural connotations. This meaning, however, is not explicitly connected to his character or role in Scripture and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Zethan as the son of Bilhan, establishing a clear paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family connections or descendants are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zethan's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, which underscores the importance of lineage and tribal identity in God's covenant people. Though not prominent in narrative events, his mention preserves the heritage of Benjamin's descendants, contributing to the biblical emphasis on God's faithfulness through generations.
